Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request and bridge letter options

Hi Olga,

We're kicking off our vendor security review for the 2026 audit window and Redwood is in scope. Can you share your SOC 2 Type II report covering the 2026 calendar year (Jan 1 2026 - Dec 31 2026)? If the full Type II report isn't yet available for that period, would you provide a bridge letter that confirms controls remained in place through Dec 31, 2026 (or a partial-period bridge)?

Also let us know the transfer options for the report (SFTP, ShareFile, secure link) and whether we need an NDA or limited distribution agreement. Ideally we need a redacted copy by May 15 to include in our audit packet.

Thanks,

Acme Analytics
natalie@acme-analytics.com

Hi Natalie — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: we can support both paths.

Options:
1) If a finalized SOC 2 Type II report for calendar 2026 is available, we will share a redacted PDF via ShareFile (password-protected link) and provide a short transfer statement. Target: 3 business days after we confirm distribution list.
2) If the full Type II report is not yet finalized for the full year, we can provide a bridge letter that covers controls through Dec 31, 2026 and a summary of scope. I've attached a checklist of typical artifacts auditors request and a bridge letter sample you can review.

Requested from you: preferred transfer method (ShareFile link or SFTP) and the list of people who must receive the document (names + emails). If you require an NDA or limited-circulation agreement, please attach that and we'll route to legal.

I've looped in Dev (security ops) and Rishi (compliance) to prepare the artifact list. If you want a hashed copy via S3 presigned URL or signed DocuSign receipt, we can accommodate that too.

Attachments: SOC2_Request_Checklist.pdf, Bridge_Letter_Sample.docx

Best,
Olga
